# Tava Labs

> Tava Labs is skincare for the ambitious. The company makes one product, the PDRN Brightening Serum, a daily complexion routine for founders and professionals who pitch, present, and record every day. Your appearance is part of your professional presence.

## Product

- [PDRN Brightening Serum](https://tavalabs.app/): The PDRN Brightening Serum costs 49 dollars as a one time purchase or 39 dollars per month as a subscription. Key ingredients are PDRN, peptides, and hyaluronic acid. Apply daily, twice a day.
- [Ingredients](https://tavalabs.app/ingredients.html): The full ingredient list and what each key ingredient does.
- [Skin Quiz](https://tavalabs.app/quiz.html): Answer a few questions and build a personal founder maintenance plan, then check out from the plan.

## Company

- [About Tava Labs](https://tavalabs.app/about.html): Skincare for the ambitious, and why Tava Labs exists.
- [Partners](https://tavalabs.app/partners.html): Accelerators, incubators, universities, and angel groups can give founders in their program a free one month supply of the serum.
- [Contact](https://tavalabs.app/contact.html): Contact Tava Labs at support@tavalabs.app for orders and product help, or at talia@tavalabs.app for general contact. Tava Labs, LLC, 1521 Blake St STE 95593, Denver, CO 80202.
